messages:
maria: Dropping a micro-proposal for a 'Connection gate' step in Private setup. Single-line status + expandable diagnostics. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/priv-conn-gate
josh: Looks good. Two quick asks: show an ETA like 'Runs in ~20s' and avoid using color alone for status (icon + text).
aisha: Copy suggestions: Success: "Connectivity verified"; Partial: "Partial reachability — see diagnostics"; Failure: "Blocked — fixes required". Change details trigger to 'View diagnostics'.
lee: Accessibility: use role="status" with aria-live="polite" while running and aria-live="assertive" for failures. Make the details toggle keyboard-focusable with aria-expanded.
sam: Export formats ops asked for: Compact, Firewall CSV, Full CIDR manifest, and PDF. Show a small kebab menu: Export ▾ and default to Compact. Include a one-line rule preview next to each port and a 'Copy all' control.
maria: For CSV columns, infra prefers service_name,port,protocol,cidr_list (semicolon-separated).
infra-bot: Compliance note: redact internal-only CIDRs unless user has org-admin scope. Show a warning modal when selecting Full CIDRs for non-admins.
josh: UX: auto-expand diagnostics only on failure. On partial, show inline suggested fixes like 'Open port 443 on LB' that expand into steps. Also add keyboard hint: 'Press R to re-run checks'.
aisha: Microcopy: change CTA to 'Re-run checks' not 'Try again' and tooltip copy to 'Copy firewall-ready rules'.
lee: Color contrast: pick darker green for success and ensure any text on colored chips meets 4.5:1. Provide a high-contrast theme for the export modal.
maria: I'll update Figma with: new heading, ETA, export menu (Compact/CSV/Full/PDF), rule preview + copy, aria-live/role changes, admin redaction flow, auto-expand on failure, and inline fix snippets. Will share updated link.
sam: I'll draft the infra CSV sample and a one-page PDF template to link from the modal.
maria: Thanks — aiming to ship the prototype to staging for an a11y pass.
